newsitem.title: UK: Bombardier approves sale of Canadair CRJ-X.
newsitem.headline: Bombardier approves sale of Canadair CRJ-X.

text.p: Canada's Bombardier Inc on Tuesday approved its Canadair CRJ-X 70 seat airliner for sale to potential clients.

Bombardier Regional Aircraft Division president Pierre Lortie said in a statement that a final decision on the launch of the aircraft was expected prior to year end, following discussions with customers and partners and a review by the company's board of directors.
Lortie said his team had been authorised to present customers with firm prices, stipulated range and performance, a detailed specification and firm delivery dates.

He said the company believed the new airliner would have the lowest trip and seat-mile costs of any jet in its class and would offer the same standard of service currently offered by its Canadair Regional Jet.
The new CRJ-X plane is a stretch version of the 50-seat Regional Jet.
